text: Transactions equal to or exceeding $5,000.00 require enhanced risk scrutiny. Investigators must verify customer transaction history, source of funds, and merchant legitimacy before clearance.
Single transactions exceeding $10,000.00 mandate immediate supervisor sign-off and step-up customer verification. Funds must remain held until manual review is completed.
When a transaction originates from an unrecognized or newly registered device with a risk score exceeding 0.70, the system must trigger a high-risk alert and recommend manual investigator review.
Any hardware device ID linked to more than one customer account within a 30-day window indicates potential coordinated fraud syndicate activity. Mandatory freeze on connected accounts.
A transaction velocity exceeding 5 attempts per rolling hour suggests automated bot testing or carding attacks. Investigators must evaluate transaction spacing and decline frequency.
Transaction velocity exceeding 10 transactions per hour mandates an immediate automated card block and immediate notification to the primary account holder.
Transactions originating from foreign jurisdictions flagged as high-risk (such as Nigeria, Russia, or Vietnam) without a recorded cardholder travel notice require secondary authorization.
Foreign currency conversions paired with sudden high-value transactions must be reviewed for unauthorized account takeover and identity theft indicators.
Transactions made from established trusted devices with normal spending patterns under $500.00 and low velocity should be auto-cleared with zero customer friction.
Investigators must ensure routine domestic purchases at habitual merchants (e.g., groceries, coffee, standard retail) are cleared promptly to maintain customer satisfaction and minimize false alarms.
